description: Check the HTTP security headers a website's home page sends: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and cookie flags. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

name: check_security_headers
title: Check security headers
